issue_context.title: Bug: Property window crashes randomly
issue_context.body:
### Description

Files suddenly crashes when repeatedly opening and closing property windows or moving sections.
The timing of the crash is random, and the same steps may or may not result in a crash.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Open and close property windows or move sections repeatedly.
2. Files crashes.

### Requirements

Do not crash.

### Files Version

2.4.61.0

### Windows Version

Windows 11 22H2

### Log file

No error log found. AccessViolationException seems to occur.
![スクリーンショット 2023-04-18 121930](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/66369541/232663074-0395b825-089e-4375-8d5f-fdfbb4a6d842.png)
comments: I can confirm this is still an issue in v2.4.80.
It seems that once the properties window is opened, the crash will then occur even when operating the main window.

review_comments: It was initially initialized as `MicaSystemBackdrop`. Is the change wanted?
Yes, this is necessary. I found WinUIEx's `MicaSystemBackdrop` isn't applied to cached windows. So I use WASDK's `MicaBackdrop`.
@hez2010 this might be useful for the work you're doing.
